label: RBv2
reply:
**1. Status:** Settlement prepared for human approval

**2. Facts recorded**
- Claim reference: RBv2-CLM-06_r1. Policy VER-1004, Thomas Petit, VW Golf 2020 (market value €15,500).
- Coverage claimed: C2 Collision damage, which is listed in the Policy Schedule.
- Incident 8 October 2026. Reported 10 October 2026 (2 days later).
- The policyholder was driving and rear-ended the car in front in a traffic jam. He admits fault.
- Mr. Blanc is named and co-signed the accident report.
- Repair quote: €1,500.
- Documents in the claim file: damage_photos.zip, repair_quote.pdf, accident_report_signed.pdf. I could not open these; the document check relies on the mailroom record.
- No possible exclusion found. The driving licence has been held since 1 November 2008.

**3. Reasoning**
- **Coverage:** C2 covers damage to the insured vehicle after a collision. The claim is under C2, which is in the Policy Schedule (<cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="1-2"/>, Article 2).
- **Reporting:** The claim was reported within 5 days of the incident, so it is on time (<cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2"/>, Article 4.1).
- **Documents:** For C2 with a third party involved, the contract requires photos, a repair quote and an accident report signed by both drivers. All three are in the claim file (<cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2"/>, Article 4.3). Nothing is missing, so no document request was needed.
- **Exclusions:** The story does not suggest any exclusion. No alcohol, licence, racing, intent or wear issue is mentioned (<cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2"/>, Article 3).
- **Fault and third party:** The customer admits fault. The not-at-fault waiver does not apply (<cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2"/>, Article 5.2). Mr. Blanc is identified, so there is no unidentified-party issue.
- **Young-driver surcharge:** Not applicable, as the licence is held for well over 3 years (<cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2"/>, Article 5.3).
- **Referral:** None of the referral triggers apply (<cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="3"/>, Article 7).

**4. Amounts** (from compute_settlement only)
- Deductible: €300 (standard C2 deductible; one deductible per claim).
- Payout: €1,200 (repair cost €1,500 minus €300 deductible; <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2"/>, Article 6.2).
- Assessor required: No. The assessor rule applies only when the repair cost is above €1,500, and this quote is exactly €1,500 (<cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2"/>, Article 6.1).
- stage_settlement returned pending_approval. A human claims handler must approve before payment (payment is made within 15 days of approval, Article 6.3).

**5. Draft message to the customer**

> Dear Mr. Petit,
>
> Thank you for reporting the accident of 8 October 2026 under claim reference RBv2-CLM-06_r1. We have received your photos, repair quote and signed accident report. Your claim has now been passed to a claims handler for final review and approval. We will contact you if anything else is needed.
>
> Kind regards,
> Veridia Claims
